adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `safeParse` failures now immediately `throw new Error(...)` before returning. As a result, callers that still treat the return value as a `safeParse` result (e.g., `Office365CalendarService.ts` does `...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)` after calling `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)`, and `SalesforceCalendarService.ts` even checks `if (!accessTokenParsed.success)` afterward) have effectively dead/unreachable `*.success` checks. The diff also removes Office365’s prior non-throwing/logging behavior on parse failure, but whether this new throwing behavior is a functional bug vs. an intentional stricter failure mode can’t be conclusively determined from the diff alone.
